The sofa is dressed with an eclectic mix of throw pillows — sage green velvet, moss green, ivory, and a muted mauve — layered casually. A low rectangular coffee table in light natural oak sits in front with a ceramic mug and a small stack of books on top. To the right, a tall fiddle-leaf fig in a simple pot adds a graphic vertical burst of glossy dark green foliage near the window. The ceiling fixture emits a playful, multicolored warm glow in hues of teal, green, amber, and pink-rose, casting dappled color onto the white ceiling.
